description: Creates or updates adherence rule sets, matched by itemId then name. A rule set that is updated takes every member of the entry.

itemId.description: The rule set's id. When it matches a stored rule set, that rule set is updated; otherwise the rule set is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

teamNames.description: The teams the rules apply to, by name; added to teamIds. Teams named must exist.

teamIds.description: The teams the rules apply to, by id.

items.description: A rule: which agent states count as adherent during an activity.

kind.description: The kind of scheduled activity the rule is for.

activityName.description: The activity code the rule is for, by name. Wins over activityCodeId.

activityCodeId.description: The activity code the rule is for, by id; null for every code of the kind.

allowedStatuses.description: The agent states that count as adherent.

allowedReasons.description: The state reasons the agent must have; empty for any reason.

startGraceMinutes.description: How many minutes after the activity starts the agent may still be in the previous activity. Defaults to 2.

endGraceMinutes.description: How many minutes before the activity ends the agent may move to the next one. Defaults to 2.

minimumOutMinutes.description: The shortest time out of adherence that counts, in minutes. Defaults to 1.

alertAfterMinutes.description: How many minutes out of adherence raise an alert. Defaults to 5.

RuleSets.description: The adherence rule sets to create or update.
